# T-1: Version repair fingerprint manifests

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
旧 canonical hash 規則で作成された version 2 manifest を migration input として検証し、current contract を version 3 として表現する。

## Acceptance Criteria
- Legacy v2 manifest verifies under its historical canonical input and converts to a v3 manifest with a current canonical hash.
- Current v3 manifests remain readable; malformed or unsupported formats fail without deleting evidence.

## Implementation Notes
RepairFingerprintManifest、RepairFingerprintReference、legacy parsing/value classes を repair-state-identity に置く。canonical input 変更と format version を同一 contract にする。

## Test Strategy
repair-state-identity unit tests: v2 legacy hash acceptance, v3 serialization/read, malformed/unsupported artifact failure.
